body.name: Two-resolution smooth profile system
body.construction: Choose fixed compactly supported \(C^\infty\) bumps so that \(Q_h\) contains \(k\asymp h^d/\ell^d\) disjoint core cubes \(C_j\) of volume \(v\asymp\ell^d\); \(\zeta_h=1\) at \(x_0\) and on their union; \(\psi_j=1\) on \(C_j\); the profile supports have fixed bounded overlap; and \(\sum_{j=1}^k\psi_j^2=1\) on \(\operatorname{supp}(\zeta_h)\).
